name: Grilled Veggie Sausage & Bell Peppers with Creamy Dill Potato Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 orange bell peppers
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and quarter bell peppers. Place in a large bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add peppers (reserve bowl for the next step) and cook, turning occasionally, until soft, 7-8 minutes. Transfer peppers to a plate and cover with aluminum foil (reserve grill pan for later use).
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl.

Return grill pan to medium heat. Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add potatoes to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; stir to combine the potato salad.
Slice cooked peppers into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide potato salad, peppers, and sausages between plates. Enjoy!
